title: Thai Guanciale Tacos
description: A fusion of Thai and Mexican flavors in a crispy taco shell, topped with roasted guanciale and fresh cilantro.
instructions: Place the guanciale on a baking sheet and roast for 10-12 minutes or until crispy.
In a small bowl, mix the Thai red curry paste and coconut oil.
Warm the tacos shells according to the package instructions.
In a separate bowl, mix the lime juice, honey, and sesame seeds.
Assemble the tacos by placing a piece of roasted guanciale on each shell, followed by a spoonful of the curry paste mixture and a sprinkle of cilantro.
Drizzle the lime juice mixture over the top and serve immediately.
